name: Text emoticon
summary: A face made of keyboard characters, read sideways in the West and upright in Japan.
how: Build the face from 3 to 12 characters of one monospace font.
Keep the face on the baseline of the line, with 1 space on each side.
Use at most 1 or 2 faces in one message.

origin.note: Scott Fahlman proposes :-) and :-( on a Carnegie Mellon message board.

adoptions.via: Japanese net users post upright faces such as (^_^) on bulletin boards and develop the kaomoji form.
